description: This file is a shell script used for managing debug tools in a software project. It includes functions for downloading, cleaning, and setting environment variables for various debug tools such as lsof, gperftools, strace, and gdb. The script handles log file setup, tool download, cleanup, and path configuration.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs a timestamped message to the log file.

methods.name: clean_debug_tool
methods.description: Cleans all or specific debug tools based on input.

methods.name: set_path_variable_lsof
methods.description: Sets PATH environment variable for lsof.

methods.name: set_path_variable_gperftools
methods.description: Sets PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for gperftools.

methods.name: set_all_path_variables
methods.description: Sets environment variables for all debug tools.
